summary:
Implemented the next Anton slice on Tires.

Added `tires.html#tire-pressure-sweep`: a four-corner iPhone pressure/status sweep with context note, local persistence, Copy, Share, Save Note to Garage Notes, Reset, Tire Card, and Garage Notes routes. Also added Search coverage, service worker bump to `ridgeline-console-v365`, shared bottom-bar Pressure route, browser-smoke coverage, `AGENT_STATE.md`, `SITE_QUALITY_AUDIT.md`, and public Anton status JSON.

Verified:
- `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('tires.html')`
- `Test-InternalLinks.ps1`
- `Invoke-SiteAudit.ps1 -Pages @('tires.html') -Tag audit-v365-tire-pressure-sweep -SkipScreenshots`
- final `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('index.html')`

Next safe slice: real-iPhone review of the Tire Pressure Sweep, Photo Atlas capture follow-up, NFC/area logging, or Garage/Maintenance visibility outside staging.

Impact Score: 4/5  
Visible Change: Tires now has a four-corner pressure sweep that can save a Garage note.  
Impact Reason: It makes a TPMS or wheel-check moment structured and usable on iPhone without changing Garage schema or vehicle facts.
